security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; media-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: A desktop cat that naps on your taskbar
bundle.longDescription: A desktop pet. A cat sits along the bottom of your screen on top of the taskbar, blinks, gets up for a walk, grooms itself and curls up for a nap when you leave it alone. Mouse input passes straight through it everywhere except its own pixels, so it never gets in the way of anything else.
